versions.changelog: Add auto-ensure-session (self-drive one-time device login; no auth dead-stop).

- Initial release of charge-my-users skill.
- Enables per-use billing of end users via SettleMesh, allowing developers to monetize AI apps by charging user wallets (with markup).
- Supports usage-based billing for paid capabilities such as LLM, image, search, and scraping APIs.
- Requires deployment and server-side integration; end-user payments triggered with X-Settle-Payer header.
- Includes setup, quoting, balance checking, and detailed error handling instructions.
